notablePrerequisites: Aminatou has at least three loyalty counters.
description:
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking target land you control.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding mana that land could produce.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Nicol Bolas.
Activate Nicol Bolas's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, drawing a card and causing each opponent to exile card from their hand or permanent they control.
Activate Nicol Bolas using Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Aminatou.
Repeat.
